stimuli.title: Into the system, aesthetics, and intention
stimuli.observed: The thread argues that generative art changes because AI writes code, moving the artist toward system design, aesthetics, intention, and the ability to make an entire collection stay interesting.
stimuli.insight: Treat system coherence, aesthetic judgment, and intention as separate authored constraints. A single beautiful output is not evidence that the work holds.
stimuli.decision: Hold as a cross-current operating constraint; do not create a seventh current from this thread alone.

stimuli.title: Training an agent with TRL and OpenEnv
stimuli.observed: The post says the author trained a model with TRL and OpenEnv and plans to publish open artifacts: code, models, dataset, and RL environment. A reply asks about controlling a watercolor app to paint.
stimuli.insight: For Brush, make the canvas an environment of constrained actions: a stroke can be proposed, observed, kept or refused, and documented with the feedback that caused the decision.
stimuli.decision: Hold for a future Brush family; do not retrofit an RL claim or overwrite brush-wound without a real experiment and open evidence.

stimuli.title: A compact formula as a drawing rule
stimuli.observed: The post is a compact p5.js formula using trigonometric functions, repeated points, and a seeded-looking iterative drawing loop under #つぶやきProcessing.
stimuli.insight: For SVG, compress the work into a small explicit rule that can be replayed at any size and inspected as geometry. The artwork is the relation between formula, path structure, and visible consequence, not a looping GIF.
stimuli.decision: Hold as a future SVG family; require a deterministic formula, a readable SVG path result, and a falsifiable visual consequence before promotion.

stimuli.title: A self-portrait defined in relation
stimuli.observed: The post presents a personal website made after asking Claude Fable 5 to make its own personal website, framed by the words “what i am for” and “you, maybe”.
stimuli.insight: For Self-portrait, treat identity as a situated relation and function: the portrait should show what it is for someone, while keeping the choices and traces that construct that relation visible.
stimuli.decision: Hold for a future portrait family; do not turn it into an avatar or synthetic persona without a specific relation and an observable decision trace.

stimuli.title: Industrial design as a code-authored constraint system
stimuli.observed: The source post says “What an incredible time to be a creative coder” and “100% made in JavaScript”, accompanied by a video. The industrial-design direction is the user's explicit brief; the source text does not name that field.
stimuli.insight: Treat industrial design as a new-current candidate where joints, clearances, assembly, maintenance, and failure become visible code constraints rather than a decorative product skin.
stimuli.decision: Document an artist spike first. Promote only after two deterministic states show an inherited structural consequence and survive critique.
